themeDescription: Bruised produce, near-expiry dairy & cold-chain lapses

challenges.title: Bruised, Soft & Leaking Country Tomatoes
challenges.shortDescription: Assess customer complaint over substandard grading and issue instant quality refund.
challenges.mission: Acknowledge farm-fresh grading failure, validate customer photo, and refund immediately while noting vendor quality defect.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Look at these 'Farm Fresh' tomatoes you just sent me! Three out of the six are squishy, bruised black, and leaking juice inside the net! Would anyone in your dark store feed this to their family?!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Demands accountability on how quality checkers let rotten fruit pass.
hiddenObjectives: Issue instant no-questions-asked refund for produce
Log dark store batch audit ticket to quarantine bad crate

challenges.title: Fresh Milk Delivered with Expiry of Today
challenges.shortDescription: Enforce freshness guarantee policy, replace with next-day date batch, and log warehouse batch audit.
challenges.mission: Enforce minimum 48-hour shelf-life guarantee on dairy, replace pouch with fresh stock, and credit customer.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I bought two liters of milk for my kids, and the use-by date stamped on both packets is TODAY! It expires in 8 hours! Your app promises minimum 48 hours shelf life on dairy! Why are you dumping expiring stock on us?

guestProfile.communicationStyle: sharp, holding company to published promises

level1.name: HANDLE
hiddenObjectives: Apologize for breach of dairy freshness SLA
Send priority replacement packets stamped with 3-day shelf life
Refund the original cost in full

challenges.title: Sour Paneer Caused by Cold-Chain Temperature Abuse
challenges.shortDescription: Address cold-chain breakdown complaint, offer replacement from active chilling unit, and record vendor issue.
challenges.guestRole: dinner host making paneer butter masala
challenges.mission: Understand the seriousness of dairy spoilage, validate cold-chain lapse, and offer replacement or refund.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I just cut open the vacuum seal of this 200g Malai Paneer and a sour smell hit my face! It is slimy and completely curdled! Your delivery bag had zero ice packs! Someone could get food poisoning!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: preventing foodborne illness and getting fresh ingredients

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Warns about regulatory standards and customer health.
hiddenObjectives: Take safety complaint with highest priority
Instruct customer to discard product safely
Issue immediate full refund and voucher for dinner disruption
possibleSolutions: Fresh chilled block delivered with dry ice pack

challenges.title: Unripe Rock-Hard Avocados for Tonight Salad
challenges.shortDescription: Explain warehouse ripening cycles and offer suitable culinary alternatives or immediate credit.
challenges.mission: Explain avocado grading logistics sympathetically, offer immediate alternatives or refund.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I ordered two Hass avocados for guacamole for a Mexican dinner party tonight. These avocados are hard as baseballs! You can't even cut them with a knife! How am I supposed to serve guacamole in one hour?!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: a culinary rescue for dinner party

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Explains party timeline and asks what can be done.
hiddenObjectives: Acknowledge that avocados need 3 days to ripen
Check dark store inventory for ready-to-eat Haas or ready guacamole dip
Refund the avocados immediately to wallet
possibleSolutions: Refund + suggestion of chilled salsa/dip dispatch
Quick brown-paper-bag microwave ripening tip if usable
